title: The asset's Work Orders tab lists every owner's work orders
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the asset's current owner.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, the asset's earlier owner.
  • Have a new asset for this test, asset 1, now owned by customer A, that earlier belonged to customer C, with work order 1 for customer C (made first, while customer C owned it) and work order 2 for customer A (made later), both at the test location and billing their own customer.
custom_steps: 1. Open asset 1's Work Orders tab from customer A's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 (customer C) and work order 2 (customer A) are both listed: 2 rows.
  • They are in today's order for this tab, work order 1 first as the older one.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12316 (Story 14, Asset Work Orders tab: whole history and Customer filter)

  • S14-R1: “The tab lists every service work order on the asset at the current location, for every customer, in today's sort.”
  • Key Decisions: “The asset's Work Orders tab shows its whole history at the current location by default, with a Customer filter matching the customer or the Bill To.”
  • Feature Overview, Release day: “The asset page's Work Orders tab lists the asset's whole history at the current location (every customer and payer), not only the current owner's work orders, and gains a Customer filter (Story 14).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
